name: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
summary: A limited series inspired by the story of how Amanda Knox was wrongfully convicted for the tragic murder of her roommate, Meredith Kercher, and her 16-year odyssey to set herself free.

name: Les Lionnes
summary: In the working-class neighborhoods of the South of France, four women with quite different profiles and in financial difficulty realize that it is not so complicated to rob a bank. They will quickly find themselves in a vicious cycle...

name: Gränsfall
summary: Johan, a border police officer in Helsingborg, dreams of a promotion, ideally to the FBI. When Rasmus, his unassuming counterpart in Helsingør, reports an armed man boarding the ferry to Sweden, Johan sees his big break. Rasmus, eager to end his shift and propose to his girlfriend, reluctantly joins Johan in pursuit. As they chase the gunman, they stumble upon what could be the corruption scandal of the century. With two mismatched cops and high stakes, what could possibly go wrong?

name: Murder: Suspect No 1
summary: In this new heart-stopping police series, we follow one of Britain's top homicide teams as a series of horrific and violent murder investigations unfold. With extraordinary access throughout each case, the series draws the viewer into the dark heart of murder investigations as the hours and minutes tick away. Can the detectives unravel what happened and who was responsible, will the police manage to confront their Murder Suspect No.1 in interview and present their evidence? And will they get the charges to stick before the suspect strikes again?

name: Alan Titchmarsh's Underdog to Superdog
summary: Meet the underdogs! They might be rescued, abandoned or just plain unruly, but these imperfect pooches all have one thing in common: they need a new purpose in life. Hosted by Alan Titchmarsh, our underdogs will be trained by experts to do incredible jobs. Each has a vision for what these dogs could achieve; from finding people lost in the wilderness, to rescuing from water, or a film stunt dog. We join them for the highs and lows of the training process, but time is ticking... Each of them must undergo a final challenge. Will these underdogs have it in them to become superdogs?

name: Başka Bir Gün
summary: Nehir is a lawyer who takes a break from her career to care for her children. Her seemingly happy marriage with her husband, Serdar, takes an unexpected turn when Serdar suddenly disappears.

name: Uprising
summary: Uprising is set to showcase some of the finest talents on the Irish music scene right now. Filmed at The Complex in Dublin's North inner-city, there'll be performances from bright new talents and established stars alike, as well as topical discussions, outspoken opinions – and, of course, lots of fun.

name: Geleceğe Kalanlar
summary: The stories of our civilization passed down from generation to generation are in the documentary "Those Who Remain for the Future"!

name: You Are a Lover in the Mortal World
summary: At the border between Jinglan and the Manchu Changmo, there is a frontier fortress called Tianlang Pass. General Xiao Chi, renowned as the "White Horse God of War," is at his subordinate's wedding banquet when he is caught trying to sneak a drink by his guards and the army cook, who forces him to drink drugs. Amid the jeers of the crowd and his pleas for mercy, the bride, Han Yunling, arrives in a red veil to perform the wedding ceremony, and he obstructs her final bow. Just then, someone reports that the bride has been forced into marriage. He swiftly dismisses the groom and imprisons him, then personally interrogates the bride. Upon seeing the bride, he immediately recognizes her as the girl who had stopped him from committing suicide and saved him as a child. He is overjoyed at their reunion but does not express it immediately. After thorough investigation, he learns that she has been forced to marry her subordinate to save her wrongly imprisoned friend Jiang Wanyu. He has Wanyu brought to him and releases the two women. Yunling returns as she does not want to owe him a favor, and she could also tell at a glance that he is critically ill and requires immediate treatment. He begs her not to reveal his condition so as not to cause panic, but she claims that she can cure his illness…

Chen Xiaohua, a good-for-nothing emperor, transforms from self-abandonment to taking responsibility with the help of his android consort, 2099. But it turns out all this happens in a virtual world. In the real world, Chen Xiaohua is on the brink of brain death. To help him awaken, Jiang Tao sacrifices her life to help Chen Xiaohua complete the turnaround mission. After he wakes up, facing his comatose girlfriend, it's his turn to save her.

name: Freshly Picked with Simon Toohey
summary: MasterChef's Simon Toohey presents a mix of his unique recipes in his own kitchen, featuring some of Australia's fresh produce producers.

name: CBC Morning Live with Heather Hiscox
summary: Start your day with live, breaking news from Canada and around the world. Heather Hiscox is in the anchor chair as host, bringing her unique perspective as one of Canada's most experienced and tenacious journalists to CBC News Network.

name: Bir Zamanlar İstanbul
summary: The series tells the story of a final-year student in the Turkish Language Department who enters the world of the mafia and changes everything, and whose paths intersect with journalist Sahar at university.

name: Exploring Off The Grid
summary: Based in Bundaberg Queensland Australia,  the team at Exploring Off the Grid love nothing more than hitting the road, tracks and water in search of Australia's idyllic places, we will travel far and wide to find old relics, wartime plane crashes, old huts and machinery. In doing so we get to see some amazing places, meet some awesome people and experience some true Australian characters. Whether it be Cape York, Tasmania, the Kimberley or anywhere in between join us on the adventure!

name: Frugal Foodie
summary: Get ready for tasty recipes that don't break the bank!

name: Roads Less Travelled
summary: An Australian Road Trip Series where we discover those hidden gems that only the local know about. We tour on some of the lesser known Roads throughout Australia.

name: The Undercover Police Scandal: Love and Lies Exposed
summary:
For more than 40 years, a secret unit of undercover police were paid to spy on ordinary members of the public. Shockingly, they included more than 60 women – deceived into deeply intimate relationships with officers who they had no idea were deployed in covert operations. The ‘spycops scandal' is the subject of an almost decade-long £88 million public inquiry into their tactics and now, a gripping three-part documentary series for ITV1 and
ITVX, The Undercover Police Scandal: Love and Lies Exposed, which will air in early
2025.
Five of the women who were deceived and blew the lid off this scandal, have entrusted ITV, makers of the award-winning drama series Mr Bates vs The Post Office, to expose how they turned detective to uncover one of the state's biggest secrets. Speaking together on camera for the first time, the creepy similarities between the women's
experiences come to light: from the way they were seduced into their relationships, to the
almost identical letters they received when they were abandoned - and ghosted - by the men they loved.
They reveal how they discovered police officers stole the identities of deceased children to create new aliases and even fathered children with the women they spied upon whilst undercover.

name: Шахматист
summary: Since childhood, Pavel was nicknamed the Chess Player - both for his passion for a noble game, and for his ability to think extraordinary, build intricate combinations, and calculate opponent's moves. All this came in handy for the Chess Player in the troubled fate that the profession of a military intelligence officer imposed on him, and the circumstances of life after leaving for a "civilian". It is not in Paul's character to indulge in the charms of civil life while there are offended people in the world.

name: Cape Carnage: Killer Catch
summary:
Cape Carnage: Killer Catch follows the Davey family, led by Captain Bruce, his wife, Juanita, and son Tiger, as they make their living in one of the most dangerous ways possible - hand line fishing in the treacherous waters of the Gulf of Carpentaria, also infamously known as Cape Carnage, off the northern coast of Australia.

The Gulf of Carpentaria is bustling with life; crocodile, tuna, and the apex predator - shark. From July to October, fishermen from all over Australia gather here to hunt for one fish in particular - the lucrative Spanish mackerel, and with some of the most sought-after flesh in the world, these are a million dollar catch worth fighting for.

Captain Bruce and his family have been fishing these waters for more than half a century, and Tiger and his wife Prue are holding with family tradition by raising their two young children aboard the family boat, M. V. Wildcard. For the four months of the year when the prized Spanish mackerel are running, these seas and the Wildcard are their home, and they take on nature by hand, battling the weather, the sharks, and sometimes themselves, as they chase their fortune.

Over ten episodes, as they face challenges at every turn, Cape Carnage: Killer Catch charts the blood, sweat and tears of the Davey family and crew through another turbulent fishing season and family life on board M. V. Wildcard.

name: Luang Kah Lah Ruk
summary: Talay, a young sergeant who has a stigma from her childhood, becomes in charge of a murder case of Tanpol, a well-off young psychologist who is suspected of killing his wife, Piangchan. As she went deeper into this case, she found many irregularities including secrets and love relations as well as threats from the anonymous murderer between those involved in this case including Talay herself.

name: The Repair Shop on the Road
summary: The Repair Shop experts are off on a road trip across the UK fixing historical treasures and precious objects that can't be brought to the barn.

previousepisode.name: Buckinghamshire - A Fix for the WWII Code Breakers

name: Alone - Überlebe die Wildnis
summary: Ten candidates are left separately in the Canadian wilderness and have to survive alone. The last one standing wins 75,000 euros. Who can last the longest?

name: Germanwings – Was geschah an Bord von Flug 9525?
summary:
On March 24, 2015, Germanwings Flight 9525 crashed in the French Alps. All 150 passengers and crew members died. After just 48 hours, the French public prosecutor's office was certain that co-pilot Andreas Lubitz deliberately caused the plane to crash.

Germanwings - Was geschah an Bord von Flug 9525? takes a meticulous look at the event and makes it clear that ten years after the crash, many questions remain unanswered - for example, relatives and aviation accident experts have identified inconsistencies that make them doubt the narrative of the French authorities. In three episodes, relatives of the victims and their lawyer Elmar Giemulla as well as journalists and other experts have their say. Aviation safety expert Simon Hradecky is also accompanied in a detailed reconstruction of the last minutes of the flight.

name: Дежурный по Кинопоиску
summary: Famous musicians, actors and actresses, bloggers, athletes, and not only are interviewed at Kinopoisk, but they also brilliantly (or not) solve difficult work tasks.

name: Kardelenler
summary: The series revolves around a family reunion years in the making. What begins as a joyous family dinner for the siblings turns into a night of unexpected confrontations, leading to a conclusion no one could foresee. After that night, nothing in their lives will ever be the same.

name: Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy
summary: In Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, Mike Holmes joins forces with his children, Michael and Sherry, as they continue his legacy – helping homeowners in need. From renovations gone wrong by crooked or incompetent contractors to bad DIY, to worthy homeowners in need of a life-changing renovation, the Holmes trio continues the work that made Mike a household name. They go behind the walls and above code to focus on safe, functional, efficient, and healthy homes. They do this while promoting a career in the skilled trades. Each project is more than just a renovation, it's an opportunity to help make people's lives better.

name: Secret Relationships
summary: Daon, a smart and handsome salary man, often clashes with his colleague Sunghyeon. Their relationship becomes more and more ambiguous as time progresses, while other figures like Jaemin, a former tutor, and heir to the company Suhyeon make their way into his life. What shape will this love square end up turning into?

name: Traveling The Spectrum
summary: An intimate glimpse into the lives of three families with a loved one on the autism spectrum as they embark on a journey of understanding.

name: Lil Kev
summary: Set in 1993 North Philadelphia, the adult animated series Lil Kev follows 12-year-old Kevin Hart, whose wild imagination and unshakable optimism constantly collide with his neighborhood's harsh realities. At the same time, his no-nonsense mother Nancy juggles night shifts as an E.R. nurse while waging a one-woman war to keep Kev on track – no easy feat with his mischievous older brother Robert blazing all the wrong trails, his trainwreck father Henry's outrageous attempts to win Nancy back, and his ex-con uncle Richard Jr.'s questionable life advice. Through it all, Lil Kev navigates his rocky upbringing with humor, hustle, and heart, surrounded by the unforgettable characters who will propel him to comedy superstardom.

name: My Pet Ate What?
summary:
My Pet Ate What? showcases real-life stories of pet owners grappling with the questionable digestive choices. Each episode features hilarious and suspenseful tales; from a Bernese Mountain Dog with a taste for intimate apparel; to the nail-biting suspense of a cat sampling "shiny treats" from their owner's wallet, and everything in between.

With more than 20 years of veterinary experience, Dr. G is one of the world's only full-time travelling animal endoscopists. Each week, Dr. G handles more than a dozen non-surgical cases, using endoscopy to locate and retrieve swallowed objects, and the outcome can range from humorous retrieval to delivering difficult diagnoses.

Aiding with the workload is Dr. G's son Ben who provides pet owners with comfort, shares the news of successful removals, and at times does a little detective work to identify mysterious finds. Together, this dynamic father-son duo combines old-school skills and fresh enthusiasm to every case.

name: The Five Star Weekend
summary: The Five Star Weekend is centered on Hollis Shaw, a famed cook and best-selling author known for her delicious recipes, impeccable taste, and warm demeanor, who suffers a devastating loss. Unable to move forward, the death starts to expose the cracks in Hollis's picture-perfect life - her strained marriage, her complicated relationship with her daughter, and her growing pursuit of validation from her fans. In an effort to overcome grief and find herself again, Hollis gets the idea to host a weekend away at her house on Nantucket with three friends from different stages in her life: her childhood, her twenties, thirties, and one surprise fifth star. Set against a luxurious and coastal backdrop, the stars will mature in ways they could never imagine as boundaries are pushed and secrets are exposed.

name: The Swift Effect
summary: Celebrating the economic impact Taylor Swift's brand has on and off-stage; exploring how she has redefined business landscapes in music, fashion, sports, education and philanthropy, generating billions of dollars and influencing global markets.

name: Pritsana Pom Mai
summary: The Yarns tells the story of a serial killer who leaves no traces, only strange knitted yarns placed on the victims. Inspector Pilanthorn partners with Sky, an autistic woman with an extraordinary ability to decode complex patterns, to uncover the meaning behind the yarns and stop the killer before the next murder takes place.

name: Ruean Chon Saeng
summary: This is the story of the tumultuous Silakhram household of Khun Luang Prasit who has five wives: first wife Phailin who has beloved daughter Kaewta; secondary wife Duean; Pim; Im who has cherished son Sin; and former servant Phum who has stepson Kuea.

name: Love @Fifty First Bite
summary: Yotsaran is sent to save his family's failing resort only to find a Khao Soi shop blocking the entrance. He clashes with Bang-Earn, the sharp-tongued owner who refuses to back down. As they fight to protect their businesses, their rivalry slowly turns into an unexpected romance. It is a story of a city boy and a feisty local girl finding love through a perfect bowl of noodles.

name: Zodiac Slayer
summary: Three individuals, each with unique birth fortunes, become bound by a shared destiny to thwart death and protect many lives. Guided by the prophecies of an old monk, the trio uncovers their intertwined fate and embarks on a critical mission. Together, they confront a formidable enemy destined to unleash catastrophe, racing against time to avert the impending disaster.

name: Love You 10 Million Miles
summary: An alien explorer crash-lands in the rural village of Don Muang and disguises himself as a local man named Bak Der. While trying to blend in, he falls in love with Bak Der's wife, Saiphin, and learns what it truly means to be human. As his departure date approaches, M29 must decide whether to return to his galaxy or stay and live a simple life with the woman who captured his heart.

name: Doubters to Believers Liverpool FC: Klopp's Era
summary: Midway through the 2023/24 season, Jürgen Klopp stuns Liverpool fans by announcing his departure. This series charts his final season and nine year tenure, showing how he turned doubters into believers and led the club to Premier League and Champions League glory. With exclusive interviews, we explore his coaching evolution, trust in young talent, and the reasons behind his emotional farewell.

name: Rise of the Empress
summary: In a crumbling empire, a royal marriage could unite warring kingdoms. When a mysterious sorceress forces a peasant girl into competing for the heir's hand, she must balance survival, romance, and the fate of the realm.

name: Nang Singh Sabad Chor
summary: Kaew and Penporn's parents were killed by a bad guy when they were little. After Kaew's escape, she was trained as a fighter by a close friend of her father. After growing up, Kaew returns to her village disguised as a man, wearing a red mask and becomes Nang Singh while she sets out to take revenge against the wrong doers. Thummo is a police officer sent on a mission to kaew's village. He is in charge of arresting Nang Singh and becomes a friend of Kaew in the meanwhile. What's more, Kaew finds herself falling in love with Thummo.

name: Ngu x Khon Song Chao
summary: Khor, a young man who does not believe in supernatural matters and does not believe in "Sleeping Godfather", sacred things that the villagers respect. He reject these beliefs until there was an event that caused him to lose his only son. People say that was because he does not respect the godfather.

name: Heman Tawan Ron
summary: Rawi, a wealthy and arrogant prince, has no choice but to marry Phetphring. Refusing any physical relationship with her, she seeks intimacy outside the home and becomes pregnant. When Rawi learns of it, she's divorced and driven out of the palace. Phetphring isn't going to say goodbye to her luxurious lifestyle so easily, however, and she and her lover Mesa devise a plan to kill Rawi. When the fight comes to pass, Rawi grabs Mesa's necklace before falling into an abyss. He wakes up in a village under the care of Lukjan. Because he has amnesia, Lukjan names him Tawan.

name: 5 Missing Teenagers
summary: Detective captain Chen Xi solves a baffling case where five teens vanish mysteriously. Her investigation uncovers intricate conflicts and hidden ties among their families, revealing a web of secrets.

name: The Great Dreamer
summary: Eighteen-year-old Xia Xia was admitted to the Law School of Nanjing University with excellent grades, but her stepfather was not prepared to support her to go to college. In order to go to school, she had to pretend to her stepfather that she left home to work and make money. After entering the school, in addition to studying every day, she was busy with part-time work and met Xie Huai, a classmate who also worked part-time outside the school to make money. Because of misunderstandings, the two did not like each other, but with Xia Xia's active approach, they gradually became familiar with each other and became partners. Xia Xia gradually understood Xie Huai's past. He avoided his studies because of his inner trauma, and worked to make money to treat his mother's illness. Xia Xia helped Xie Huai regain his ideals and face his studies. The two also gradually developed feelings in mutual help and healing. As Xie Huai was about to graduate from university, his mother had to go abroad for treatment due to worsening illness, and had to separate from Xia Xia.

name: How I Escaped My Cult
summary: How I Escaped My Cult is a riveting true crime series that takes viewers into insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice, each episode follows the unique and harrowing journey of a survivor from their earliest cult experiences and revelations all the way up to their heart-pounding escapes.

name: A Travessia
summary: More than 100 years ago, Sacadura Cabral and Gago Coutinho revolutionized air navigation technology by making the first South Atlantic connection between March 30 and June 17, 1922, connecting Lisbon to Rio de Janeiro. We follow Portuguese aviation pioneers Gago Coutinho and Sacadura Cabral in their fearless race to cross the South Atlantic, driven by a strong spirit of adventure, challenging the limits of human endeavour as they navigated unknown skies. His scientific achievements and innovations in astronomical navigation revealed the way to other planets in the universe.

name: Dare to Defy
summary: Richard Whitehead MBE and Adele Roberts embark on a powerful journey to transform sport, breaking down barriers for under-represented communities as they create the most inclusive running event ever. Through personal stories and inspiring encounters with fearless individuals who dare to defy their own sporting expectations, they reveal a bold new vision of what it truly means to belong in sport.

name: Rideau de fer - L'occupation soviétique
summary: How did the Soviet Union impose its communist ideology on central and eastern Europe after the Second World War? From 1945 until the building of the Berlin Wall in 1961, citizens of central and eastern Europe tell their stories of how their countries were occupied and transformed into communist states.

name: Australian Open Water Championships
summary: Highlights of The Australian Open Water Championships from Busselton, WA.

name: Wicked Game: The Devil in the Desert
summary:
After a sheriff's deputy found a woman zip-tied and frantic on the side of the road in the Mojave Desert in 2012, authorities discovered this may have been a grisly crime in pursuit of a suspected buried treasure. This discovery kicked off a years-long investigation that spanned sting operations, an international search, a prison break captured on cellphone, and a courtroom showdown between lead prosecutor Matt Murphy and the man authorities believed was pulling the strings in a twisted game of greed and violence — Hossein Nayeri. 

Set during the early days of medical marijuana, Wicked Game: Devil in the Desert is a gripping three-part docuseries told through intimate access inside the case and to those who lived the story unlike any other. The docuseries showcases rare evidence stills, body cam and dash cam videos of gripping key moments, recorded police interviews with the victims and suspects, and features new interviews with the lead prosecutor and deputy counsel and the lead detective on the case. The series also incorporates "20/20"'s groundbreaking past reporting on the case, including archival interviews with victims and Nayeri, the so-called mastermind himself.

name: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
summary:
In the wealthy suburbs of Indianapolis, husband and father of three Herb Baumeister led a double life — businessman by day, serial killer by night. Throughout the 1990s, he targeted gay men, amassing a victim count possibly surpassing that of Jeffrey Dahmer. The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer is a four-part series that follows Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison as he launches a new investigation decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, missing evidence, and a key witness whose story keeps changing. 

Through never-before-seen archival footage and new interviews with those central to the story, this new docuseries explores how the murders went undetected. In an exclusive interview, a Baumeister survivor, Mark Goodyear, emerges from the shadows, revealing his face for the first time in an on-camera interview, raising more questions about his relationship with the man he says wanted to kill him. Additional interviews include investigators involved in the original case and new investigation, relatives of Baumeister's victims, the current owner of Fox Hollow Farm, and the cold case experts working to bring closure for families still waiting for answers.

previousepisode.name: Return to Fox Hollow: New Victims, Darker Secrets

name: Let's Eat With George
summary: In the first season of 'Let's eat' with George, follow him as he embarks on the ultimate foodie quest, uncovering the best of home and restaurant cooking.

name: Pool Spa Life Australia
summary: Hosted by Walt Collins (Buy to Build, Healthy Homes Australia, Animal Extra and Country House Facelift), Pool Spa Life Australia will delve into the nuts and bolts of planning, building, maintaining and owning your very own Aussie backyard dream - a shimmering pool or spa!  We'll talk to experts from industry about every angle of pool and spa life. The series will cover everything poolside, including ideas for landscaping, furniture, how to choose a pool, running a sustainable backyard and the latest in innovations and technology.

name: Ozoff Road TV
summary: From the Outback to the bush, from the bottom end to the top end, the team at Oz Off Road TV takes you to some of the most amazing locations Australia has to offer.

name: Helping Hands
summary: Celebrating the people and organisations across Australia who make the world a better place.

name: Invictus Games Highlights
summary: Highlights from the Invictus Games.

name: Super Rugby Pacific Post-Match
summary: Post match analysis and interviews from tonight's match live from the ground and a look forward to next weeks matches.

name: The Hack
summary:
ITV has commissioned The Hack, a 7-part ITV Studios co-production with Stan, Australia about the phone hacking scandal written by BAFTA, Tony and Olivier award winning screenwriter, Jack Thorne, with David Tennant, Robert Carlyle and Toby Jones in leading roles and produced by the team from Mr Bates vs The Post Office. 

Set between 2002 and 2012, the drama deftly interweaves two real life stories, the work of investigative journalist Nick Davies, played by David Tennant, who uncovered evidence of phone hacking at the News of the World, and running parallel, the story of the investigation into the unsolved murder of private investigator Daniel Morgan, led by former Met Police Detective Chief Superintendent Dave Cook, played by Robert Carlyle.  Toby Jones plays former Editor-in Chief of The Guardian, Alan Rusbridger.

name: Azúcar
summary: A bereaved mother curses the Solaz lineage after her newborn is taken away, vowing vengeance against those who exiled her.

name: Optics
summary: Optics follows two whip-smart 20-something women who are unexpectedly promoted to run crisis management PR firm Fritz & Randell, after the death of office patriarch Frank Fritz. As they battle weekly public relations crises from celebrities, sports stars and corporate titans, and power challenges from veteran PR flack Ian Randell, they slowly come to realise that their firm might have a scandal brewing of its own, and start to wonder: have they been set up to fail?

name: Marble Hall Murders
summary:
Susan Ryeland, is a book editor who all too often finds herself involved in baffling murders. Returning to England, she is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. "Pünd's Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the book and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

Atticus Pünd, the literary detective, steps out of the books to help Susan unravel the real-life mystery. Who killed Miriam Crace, the most famous children's author in the world?

name: Reverend Gadget's Garage
summary: In an old lightbulb factory in South Central Los Angeles, Reverend Gadget is converting classic cars into powerful electric vehicles. A mad-scientist, real-life Doc Brown from Back to the Future, Gadget is saving the planet, one car at a time!

previousepisode.name: We Have No Manual For This!

name: The Golden Bull Agent
summary: This story follows the covert mission of four "tigers," elite spies concealing themselves to wipe clean the evil path of mogul Pa Sing. Pa Sing excersises great influence over the village of Ban Huai Krathing Thong. Outwardly, he's a benign help to the villagers. Behind the scenes, however, he's running illegal business. Four exeptional talents are therefore gathered from round the county to take up the secret Golden Bull mission and infiltrate Sing's territory. Jak works on the railroad, Khatha becomes an able seaman on a passenger ship, Sang a Likay star and Mai-ek a comedian. They face many direct obstacles from Sing's right-hand man Big and Sing's three wives Fonthong, Judy and Khaikung as well as obstacles of the heart. Jak is faced with police officer Kathi—the daughter of the village head—and Khatha has feelings for Pa Sing's daughter Dujdao.

name: Love and Scandal
summary: Urajawasi has a perfect life with her boyfriend Rames until her cousin Inthu-orn comes to her with a vengeful heart. Inthu-orn is fabricated that Urajawasi's family involves in her mother's death, so she spreads scandals while pretending to be a good person. However, Urajawasi is not an innocent woman. She sees through Inthu-orn's mask. Will the conflict between them be solved or will the real mastermind behind their misunderstanding be smiling behind the curtain?

name: Sapai Ka Fak
summary: Kwanjit is a singer in a restaurant, and she falls in love with an American doctor. He promises to marry her and goes home to tell his relatives, but he never comes back. The young pregnant girl is heavily ridiculed by the people of her hometown, and she decides to move to Bangkok, where she gives birth to her daughter, Rainie.

name: Ghoul to School
summary: Khru Phensri is the principal of Nongmaeped Witthaya School. With the school at risk of being shut down, Khru Phensri does all she can to prepare her school for assessment. As part of her efforts, she hires a beautiful new English teacher Khru Lady. Shortly after Lady's arrival, the school's chickens are found brutally slaughtered. Khru Phensri witnessed Lady consume raw entrails and believes her to be a ghoul. Khru Phensri wants nothing more than to expose Khru Lady, but Lady is a caring and beloved teacher. Plus, her kind little brother Khru Boy has feelings for Lady.

name: Sapai Ka Fak
summary: Rainie is raised by her mother because her father left to America and never returned. Rainie finds herself needing money for her mother's medical expenses and ends up becoming a girlfriend for her hire to wealthy heir Traikhun.

name: Selina's Gold
summary: Selina's father sells her to Tiago who makes her a sex slave. With the help of Domeng, Tiago's blind slave, she plans their way out of this living hell.

previousepisode.name: Les trésors du château de Fontainebleau

name: T.I.R.
summary: T.I.R. (Due assi per un Turbo) is an Italian-Hungarian television series produced between 1984 and 1987 and released in 1987. It follows the lives of two truck drivers. Each episode tells a standalone story, with no overarching plot connecting them. The main characters are two Italian truck drivers, Franco and Giovanni.

name: Tiệm ăn của quỷ
summary: In a secluded part of town, a mysterious chef cooks up supernatural meals that grant his guests' deepest desires – if they're willing to pay the price.

name: The Queen Who Crowns: Before Sunrise
summary: A romance drama depicting the fateful first meeting between 'Won Kyung', who dreamed of a new world before embracing the world, and 'Bang Won', who shared the same aspirations as her.

name: Juniors Café
summary: When the affluent Hayes family moves to Attaway to take over the beloved Junior's Cafe, they're determined to turn it into the flagship of their new coffee empire. Siblings Jackson and Mallory will navigate the ups and downs of running a coffee shop alongside siblings Felix and Tara, testing their relationships—both familial and professional. Can they blend their ambitions with the realities of their new small-town life without spilling the beans?

previousepisode.name: She Made Up a Fake Ex-Boyfriend?!

name: Little House on the Prairie
summary: A transformed adaptation of Wilder's semi-autobiographical books, the new Little House on the Prairie is part family drama, part epic survival tale, and part origin story of the American West. The series will offer a kaleidoscopic view of the struggles and triumphs of those who shaped the frontier.

name: Design My Space: Atlanta
summary: Design My Space: Atlanta is the ultimate home makeover series where fresh starts meet bold transformations on a budget. An award-winning designer helps deserving Atlanta residents—first-time homeowners, empty nesters, and entrepreneurs—reimagine their spaces with stunning yet affordable makeovers that empower them to embrace new chapters in their lives.

name: Juego de voces
summary: Juego de Voces, De tal palo tal astilla, It's a musical game show where two teams of famous stars, one consisting of parents and the other of their children, compete in different singing styles.

name: The Forgotten Empire
summary: Historian David Olusoga embarks on a journey to unearth an eye-opening account of Britain's place in the world, looking beyond the Victorian clichés to reveal new aspects of the imperial story and encounter forgotten communities across the globe with whom we have a shared history.

name: Ashley Cain: Into the Danger Zone
summary: A brand new six-part series from True North in association with House of Panthera for BBC Three and iPlayer, in which former footballer Ashley Cain visits some of the world's most dangerous cities to explore the issues that affect young men born into a life that exists on the fringes of society.

name: Gelboys
summary: Fourmod, a lovestruck high schooler, falls for Chian, a gel-nails enthusiast, but learns he's not the only one invited for nail dates. With help from his friend Babin, he plots to make Chian jealous and feel what it's like to be left in a "situationship".

name: Tale of the Nine Tailed: An Unfinished Story
summary: The 3 episode spinoff will tell the story of Lee Rang and Ki Yoo Ri before and during the events of "Tale of the Nine-Tailed."

name: Uncanny: Post Mortem
summary: They know what they saw. Danny's joined by celebs and experts from Team Sceptic and Team Believer for an even deeper dive into the weird world of the paranormal.

name: Lady Behind the Mask
summary: Kung is a graceful, beautiful woman who has grown up in the slum, with a mysterious background about her birth. Due to employment obligations, Kung finds herself traveling to Kheha Nang Khoi which is located on a cliff. She is employed as a caretaker for a mentally challenged woman who wears a mask all the time. Kung later discovers that the lady is not crazy and may be related to precious lost jewelry, "The Pink Diamond".

name: Pang Sanaeha
summary: After a failed operation to capture the infamous drug dealer, Jiang, Investigator Techit finds himself traveling to his friend Sritang's resort in order to take a break. There, he meets a sweet-voiced ghost who haunts his room and can not remember anything about her past. He decides to call her Siangwaan because of her pretty voice, and the two then begin to find out her real identity.

name: Rhett & Link's Wonderhole
summary: From outrageous challenges to heartwarming encounters, through docu-comedy, music and sketch Rhett and Link's Wonderhole pushes the boundaries of entertainment, delivering an experience that is both hilarious and thought-provoking.

name: Frauds
summary:
We pick up the story as Sam anxiously waits for Bert to be released from a maximum-security prison on grounds of compassionate discharge. Frail and facing her final days, following a cancer diagnosis, Bert's mindset is as it's always been, to take risks and live life on the edge. 

Set in the picturesque mountainous region of Southern Spain, it's apparent from the outset that Sam and Bert have unresolved issues of the thieving kind.

Locked into a pattern of fierce friendship coupled with deep mistrust, that goes back many years, Bert apparently has no one else to turn to in the final weeks of her life. And we sense this isn't going to be an easy ride for Sam, who is clearly burying feelings of guilt, and a past she'd rather stay forgotten.

Pricked by those feelings, she reluctantly agrees to give her ailing former friend a bed in the idyllic smallholding she calls a home. Despite trying to keep Bert at a distance, she is immediately pulled back into their complex and addictive relationship.

On the pretext of one final, multi-million-pound art heist, Bert attempts to lure Sam out of retirement, but at what cost?  Can Sam stay one step ahead of her former friend, who is clearly capable of treachery? Or will the push and pull of their toxic friendship see them both ruined before they are able to pull off the job and escape one another for good?

name: Gerry Hutch: AKA The Monk
summary: With unprecedented access to archive footage and extensive new background research this is the up-to-date story of Gerry Hutch by some of those who know his life best.

name: Rarng Ruk Prang Jai
summary: Tiwtawat, Karawat's brother was murdered in a shooting. Getusa mysteriously disappears and reappears with no memories of herself or her twin sister, Getapa, who is now missing. Suddenly becoming a suspect in the case, Getusa teams up with Karawat to investigate what really happened. However, while searching for answers and also a way to recover her memories... romance begins to rise between Karawat and Getusa.

name: Hero 1000 Ruk
summary: The war became more intense when instead had to cooperate with the national security forces to stop their brothers. The bloodline went wildly in the midst of resentment, power, love and death of Peva. The mother who wanted to stop both sons The death of Pevan led to the mystery of Pharaoh when Tai knew.That Pharaoh is Gaddesh The true father, Tai, decided to leave the Pharaoh kingdom to cooperate with instead of stopping the war between humans and robots. Finally, instead of Tai, can they join hands to stop the war between humans and robots?

name: Kharze Zarka
summary: The tale of two families, one is Syrian and the other is Lebanese, who are united by many harsh conditions and challenges, yet things become more difficult when Zain falls for Alia, the daughter of the other family.

name: А.М.
summary: A.M. is an eight-part dramedy series about the life of each of us through the stories of Azamat Musagaliev.

name: Superfakes
summary: Superfakes is a crime drama series that follows a small-time Chinatown luxury counterfeit dealer who enters a dangerous black market underworld in order to fund a life of suburban respectability for her family.

name: Who's Behind Black Art
summary: Who's Behind Black Art is a compelling four-part docuseries that dives into the lives of five emerging artists—Adrian Armstrong, Jewel Ham, Laurena Finéus, Mario Joyce, and Tae Ham—as they navigate the art world and the unique challenges often faced by artists of color. These talented individuals are part of the Good Black Art community, a groundbreaking platform founded by Philip Collins, fully dedicated to supporting emerging Black artists.

name: Filthy Fortunes
summary: Filthy Fortunes spotlights Matt Paxton and his team as they complete the most squalid and hazardous jobs to help everyday Americans cash in. Before the treasure hunt can begin, Matt will assess the property to determine potential costs associated with the clean-out and estimate the value of items hidden inside the hoard. With each property, he wagers that he'll discover enough to cover all the costs and make a profit. Matt takes all the risk, and if all goes according to plan, it's a win-win situation for both him and the client.

name: Tom Green Country
summary: Tom Green Country offers a funny and heartwarming glimpse into the hilarious life of the infamous comedian as he relocates from Los Angeles to a simpler life on his new remote farm. But farm life isn't easy. Tom scrambles to repair his century-old barns, build fences, install a chicken coop and take ownership of a variety of livestock! Has Tom Green finally bitten off more than he can chew?

name: Riquísimos...por cierto
summary: A spin-off of "Vecinos", this series proves that money does not change people, it reveals them, When the López Pérez family receives the news that their uncle Fidel, the cacique of Angangueo, passed away and left them his fortune, their lives take a dramatic turn. Now living in an a luxurious mansion in Las Lomas that they inherited, the López Pérez have everything they always dreamed of--wealth, indulgence, and plenty of chaos.  Think of them as a Mexican version of the Kardashians. But as they soon discover, money doesn't hide the naco—it just makes it shine. What won't Doña Magda, Don Arturo, Alejandra, Rocko and Morris do with millions of pesos?

name: 40 y 20
summary: The series follows Paco, a forty-something divorcé with a fascination for younger women, his son Fran, a twenty-something with a weakness for women in their forties. Together, they enjoy every weekend together in good company.

name: Six Nations Highlights
summary: Highlights of all the action and drama from the weekend's Six Nations.

name: American Murder: Gabby Petito
summary: What happened in the final days of Gabby Petito's life? In this gripping true-crime series, her loved ones reveal the untold story of her tragic murder.

name: Olympo
summary: After her best friend collapses in training, talented swimmer Amaia stops at nothing to uncover the truth — even if it risks her Olympic dreams.

name: Paul American
summary: After growing up in front of the world as some of the earliest content creators, global internet sensations Jake and Logan Paul are venturing into a brand-new arena: reality TV. Two of the biggest athletes in sports entertainment, the Pauls' burgeoning empire includes over 150 million followers, a game-changing fight promotion company, a fast-growing sports drink brand, a disruptive sports gaming and media company, a record-breaking men's personal care line, and WWE championships. For two decades, the Pauls' lives have been incredibly public yet highly curated through an internet lens. Now, with unparalleled access to the Paul family and their inner circle, Paul American peels back the curtain on the most raw, honest, and intimate moments in the brothers' over-the-top, high-octane lives.

name: Son of a Donkey
summary: We meet Theo just as he moves out of his home to claim his independence — until he's faced with the harsh realities of adulthood. From driving fines and daddy issues to internet scams and a lot of therapy, Theo and his best friend Johnny get up to their usual antics as they come to terms with what's most important: family.

name: Die Falle
summary: Successful author Lisa Konrad hasn't left her house in nearly ten years, ever since she witnessed the murder of her sister Anna. But when she believes she recognizes the killer on television, she sets out to trap him — using herself as the bait.

name: Motorvalley
summary: Arturo, Elena and Blu have lost almost everything in their lives, but one thing still lights them up: the love for cars and adrenaline. Elena, a young member of the Dionisi family, owner of a famous motorsport team, must regain a role in the family business, now in the hands of her brother; she hires Blu, a young hothead with a fatal attraction to speed, and Arturo, a famous pilot who has now fallen from grace, to train her. Each of them has a reason to run faster than the others.

name: The Secret of the Shiledars
summary: A secret society unravels a hidden treasure belonging to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, with Rajeev leading the quest to protect it from falling into wrong hands, ultimately becoming the chief of the Shiledars.

name: Expedition: Search for the Nile
summary:
Stepping into the shoes of one of Britain's greatest Explorers, Ben Fogle and Dwayne Fields head into the heart of Africa in search of Dr David Livingstone, and the race for the source of the Nile.

Africa is the world's second largest continent, three times the size of Europe, and yet until around 150 years ago more of the Moon had been mapped than this vast area. At its heart is the world's longest river, the Nile. For millennia, humans had sought the mythical source of the Nile, but all had failed. In the mid 19th Century, at the height of Britain's imperial power, it became an obsession, one that attracted extraordinary men to achieve incredible feats. This obsession inspired a race that would bring victory for one, failure for many and death for others.

Following on from their BAFTA nominated series Endurance: Race to the Pole, adventurers Ben Fogle and Dwayne Fields immerse themselves into the extremes that African explorers like Livingstone, Burton, Speke and Stanley faced in their quest to find the Nile's source. Ben and Dwayne wear the same clothes, eat the same food, rely on the same kit and tread the same paths as these extraordinary Victorian explorers. Reliving the dangers, facing the challenges and ultimately experiencing first-hand the Race for the Nile.

name: Сделка
summary:
Alla and Lyuda have been friends for a long time. Both women are successful, attractive and rich. They trust each other like no one else, and they cope with all difficulties together. But suddenly Alla has big problems at work. An unknown client makes a deal: he takes out a loan for five cars and disappears with the cars and the money. Alla is on the verge of ruin. Who is this mysterious client?

It turns out that Alla's best friend has become an accomplice in the scam. Alla cannot forgive Lyuda for betraying her. But Lyuda claims that she was deceived herself. For the first time in many years, the heroines of the series "Deal" quarrel. Who is playing the game? And who is the victim?

name: The Big Idea Works
summary: From paper to prototype. Sara Davies brings together people with amazing concepts and the brilliant makers who can turn them into reality. Can they make the big idea work?

name: The Balkans: Europe's Forgotten Frontier
summary: Thirty years on from the Yugoslav wars of independence, Katya Adler finds a beautiful region undergoing rapid change. But what's next for this often overlooked corner of Europe?

name: 50,000 First Dates: A True Story
summary: When Nesh Pillay wakes up with no memory of her fiancé JJ Jakope, mistaking him for an Uber driver, their love is put to the ultimate test. Dubbed "The Real-Life 50 First Dates Couple," their story captures hearts worldwide as they face the question: can love survive when memories don't?

name: EastEnders Revealed
summary: Behind the scenes in Albert Square.

name: Dylan McGrath's Secret Service
summary: 60 guests have been invited to Dylan's Fade St Social restaurant to raise funds for WALK, Spirasi, Release and The Finglas Traveller Development fund. The diners anticipate a fine dining experience of the calibre Dylan is renowned for, so his reputation is at stake. Can Stephen, Lisa-Marie, Rosine, Luke and Fiadhnait deliver the quality food expected? As Dylan's secret service in the kitchen, they seem confident but facing such a massive test, Dylan is worried that they might not pull it off.

name: Bad Boys vs Crazy Girls
summary: Bad Boys vs Crazy Girls tells the story of the most popular boy and girl who hate each other have the surprise of their lives when they find out that they are engaged. For Kate, Liam is her mortal enemy.

name: Only in Aotearoa
summary: Short, sharp, comedy skits told from a distinctly Māori perspective, with real-time conversations between characters that mirror an issue or common experience that affects Māori in a funny, feel-good fashion.

name: Dear You
summary: Alma, a young Parisian, juggles between her professional life in a palace and a complex love life. Combining love, humor and sensuality, this French romance depicts today's romantic and friendly relationships through the eyes of a generation that is connected, open, demanding and in search of meaning.

name: Sheltered
summary: Sheltered is a single-cam series that tells the story of the misfit volunteers at an overworked and underfunded pet rescue who often feel as complicated, lonely, and ‘unlovable' as the difficult dogs and cats in their care.

name: Hero Inside
summary: Heroes can pop out of their comic books when summoned in this comedic action-adventure.

name: Holo no Graffiti
summary: From unraveling the secrets of opening and closing doors to defusing surprise packages more commonly known as bombs, there is never a dull day at the Hololive Production office! Holo no Graffiti follows an eccentric cast of Virtual YouTubers, also known as "VTubers," going about their absurd yet hilarious daily lives, detailing all their cute moments and mishaps.

previousepisode.name: Three Years on the Run... It's Babyvent!

name: My Syblings Romance
summary: Dating show with a family twist. Four pairs of biological brothers and sisters, share a house to assist each other in finding love. No one can reveal who their sibling is. Romantic feelings will be revealed during their 10 day stay.

name: Qing Dui Wo Xin Dong Ba
summary: Su Qiang Wei was originally a well-known obstetrician and gynecologist, but she was fired by the hospital because of her ex-husband's lover. Her hand was injured, and she could no longer perform surgery. She heard that the well-known overbearing boss's family was recruiting a physical therapist for his grandmother, and went to apply for the high salary. But she didn't realise that Huo Si Ting was looking for a wife, and she had always thought she was just applying to be the family doctor.

name: Natural Born Killer
summary:
Natural Born Killer is the definitive story of how the police stopped a serial killer in his tracks. School janitor Vincent Stanford was on his way to becoming Australia's worst serial killer, following the brutal murder of bride-to-be Stephanie Scott, and a range of plans to murder many others. Even more shocking is the theory that Vincent most likely practised his murderous craft in Europe for 20 years prior.

This is the story of his conviction, his chilling confession, his possible involvement in other cases, and how he almost got away with it due to the DNA confusion with his identical twin brother.

name: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX
summary: Amate Yuzuriha is a high-school student living peacefully in a space colony floating in outer space. When she meets a war refugee named Nyaan, Amate is drawn into the illegal mobile suit dueling sport known as Clan Battle. Under the entry name "Machu," she throws herself into fierce battle day after day, piloting the GQuuuuuuX. Then an unidentified Gundam mobile suit pursued by both the space force and the police appears before her, along with its pilot, a boy named Shūji.

name: WWE Evolve
summary: WWE Evolve will introduce viewers to the most intense and charismatic prospects recruited from college athletics and independent wrestling as they strive to build their in-ring careers and elevate their personas. WWE Evolve will prominently feature talent from WWE's world-class Performance Center in Orlando, Fla., and WWE ID, a first-of-its-kind developmental program.

name: Giant Hubs
summary: Trains, planes or maritime travel – innumerable travellers use these junctions that catapult them to new adventures every day. What kind of planning and logistics are necessary to make the commute, the flight, the trip of millions and millions of individuals possible at all? What goes on behind the scenes to insure that everyone gets where they need to go in a timely manner? Giant Hubs will take the viewer behind the scenes of this almost impossible endeavour and find answers to these and to a lot more questions.

name: Trains en guerre
summary: Examines four famous European battles of World War II: the Battle of Britain, the failure of Barbarossa, Operation Overlord and the liberation of France.

name: Le Rai Game Luang
summary: The rivalry between two famous actresses begins when the seemingly perfect married life of Phatchanin turns into a bitter pill. Ingdao seeks revenge, aiming to shatter Phatchanin's life over an old grudge. But the game doesn't involve only them—an ambitious businessman with his own vendetta enters the scene, stirring emotions and complicating the stakes, along with a resilient girl nearly led astray by a revenge she didn't cause.

name: Hamish & Andy's Caravan of Courage
summary: Hamish and Andy embark on an adventure - touring in their trusty motorhome.

name: The Arsenio Hall Show
summary: The Arsenio Hall Show is an American syndicated late-night talk show created by and starring comedian Arsenio Hall. There have been two different incarnations of The Arsenio Hall Show. The original series premiered on January 3, 1989, and ran until May 27, 1994. Nineteen years after the original series left television, Hall returned for a revival that premiered on September 9, 2013 and was cancelled after one season, with the finale airing on May 21, 2014.

name: Everlasting Love
summary: A modern archaeology student is transported to the past, becoming the wife of vengeful tyrant Feng Zhi Li. Amid palace intrigues, alliances, and war preparations, Feng Zhi Li's advisor falls for the brave Princess Feng Zhi Fan. Together, they face the trials of love, duty, and destiny.

name: Last Meal Universe
summary:
Shun is a galactic civil engineer with a unique assignment: demolishing Earth to make way for a new intergalactic expressway. Naturally, earthlings have no clue of this impending doom. 

On his first day on earth, Chondan, the owner of a quaint Thai restaurant, enthralls Shun with his mouthwatering homemade dishes. Consequently, Shun secretly postpones his world-ending plan, lured by the promise of more delicious meals with Chondan. If he ever grows tired of the flavours, he can return to his original mission.

name: Ellie Simmonds
summary: A series of documentaries presented by Paralympian Ellie Simmonds.

previousepisode.name: Ellie Simmonds: Finding My Secret Family

name: Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code
summary:
This three-part documentary series sees award-winning actor, presenter, and comedian Bradley Walsh fulfil a lifetime's ambition to visit the monuments of Ancient Egypt and try to understand how it could have been possible to produce such "wonders of the ancient world" 4,500 years ago.

In this series, viewers will see Bradley as never before as he reveals his engineering passion and expertise and has many questions and theories that challenge Egyptological orthodoxy, getting close and personal with the monuments and history with which he has been fascinated throughout his life. With his Indiana Jones hat, his unique brand of entertainment and his unusual camel-riding technique, it's fair to say that Bradley is unlike anyone the Egyptians (ancient or modern) have ever encountered before.

name: Aitana: Metamorphosis
summary: In this documentary series, Aitana reveals intimate moments and reflects on her journey from regular teen to international pop sensation.

name: My Haunted Hometown
summary:
Think your hometown is safe? Think again. My Haunted Hometown will have you questioning everything you know about the town you love. This brand-new series is an immersive, original, and dynamic road trip to small and scary towns across North America.

Following the terrifying stories of three paranormal witnesses per episode, we learn exactly how the past can come back to haunt you. We relive the most frightening moments of our witnesses' lives inside the harrowing location that the hauntings occurred in. And find out which spirits, ghosts, and demons also call these towns home.

name: Investigation of Love
summary: Lawyer Pat's first encounter with Wasu, an enthusiastic politician of a newer generation, doesn't go so smoothly. Fate keeps putting them in each others paths, however, and they ultimately end up working together investigating a case concerning a powerful figure, sparking a transformation in their relationship.

name: Past Life, Present Love
summary: After a family emergency forces Mild to end her engagement and rush home, a car crash unexpectedly brings back her lost love with a bizarre twist.

name: Blessing of Love
summary: Daotok is trapped in the human world without realizing he is already dead. Until one boy named Mew takes over his empty room, and all the truth starts to come to light. Within a limited time frame of 30 days, Daotok must find true love to be able to transcend time and space. Otherwise his soul would vanish forever, unable to reincarnate.

name: Деньги не пахнут
summary:
"Money Doesn't Smell" is a documentary bombshell that shatters the myth of "honest business." Stas Ay Kak Prosto (Stas Like It's Simple) takes viewers into a world where the "heroes" are the ones we despise. The "geniuses" are those even dictators feared. And success is synonymous with crime.  

The show doesn't aim to shock. It reveals the machinery that grinds lives into profit. Why do we buy products from killer corporations? How do con artists in Armani suits become Forbes icons? And why is there a corpse behind every "brilliant startup"?

"Money Doesn't Smell" is a mirror in which capitalism sees its true face. No Photoshop. Sit back and watch. After this, you'll stop trusting logos. You'll start trusting only facts.

previousepisode.name: Боинг: на крыльях лжи | Крах авиационной империи | Убийства информаторов и крушения самолетов | Деньги не пахнут | Эпизод 8

name: Масяня в Швеции
summary: Masyanya talks about Sweden

name: Women's Sports Now
summary: Women's Sports Now will dive deep into the stories of the elite women at the heart of these games. Women's Sports Now will be fans' go-to source for everything from women's basketball, volleyball, soccer, college basketball, and more.

name: Salvage Hunters: Georgian House Restoration
summary: Drew Pritchard has bought a house in the country that needs major renovations.

name: CBS Evening News Plus
summary: CBS Evening News Plus, a 30-minute continuation of its overhauled flagship newscast that will stream online.

name: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Break Time
summary: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Break Time (Re:ゼロから始める休憩時間(ブレイクタイム)) is a mini anime produced by Studio Puyukai. It is a series of animated shorts meant to complement the main anime.

name: Likteņa līdumnieki
summary: It is based on Vladimir Kaijak's powerful novels tells the history of the Latvian family - the Nārbuļi family - from 1885 to all the events of the 20th century in the history of Latvia up to 1995.

name: Joseline's Cabaret Texas Reunion
summary: The ladies from Season 5 reunite on stage in LA. Hosted by the Puerto Rican Princess Joseline Hernandez and Janeisha John.

name: Mass Effect
summary: Commander Shepard, a human soldier, battles the Reapers, a hostile alien race threatening humanity's existence in the 22nd century.

name: Néro
summary: Southern France, 1504. Nero is a cynical and surly assassin who is betrayed by his master and long-term ally. Running from the dangerous enemies now after him, he discovers his own orphaned daughter Perla. On their journey between vengeance and redemption, Nero will have to choose: saving himself or saving his daughter — and the world.

name: La Haine : La scène est à nous
Mea Culpa
summary: 25 years after a tragedy that affected her and her friends, Bérénice is a restorative justice mediator. But is it possible to believe in rehabilitation? Especially now, with the culprit back in their lives.

name: L'Appel
summary: In 1997, the biker war in Quebec reached its peak when two prison guards were murdered. Prosecutor France Charbonneau and the Carcajou squad joined forces to put an end to Maurice Boucher's reign of violence.

name: Jay & Pamela
summary: Jay & Pamela following a couple who also happen to share the same rare brittle bone disorder. Their lives are full of unique and difficult physical challenges, but their enduring enthusiasm is contagious. With plans to marry and a goal to live more independently, Jay and Pamela navigate the world in their motorized wheelchairs, determined to build the life of their dreams together.

previousepisode.name: I See You, I Choose You

name: Fils De
summary: Gangster Franck Pistone, who's been on the run for 17 years after having pulling off the heist of the century, returns to Brussels to reconcile with his children because he feels his end is near.

name: Dala Bupha Khattakam
summary: When her client dies on the eve of his wedding, a florist sets out to find the killer, unearthing high society's dark secrets — while keeping her own.

name: Lugar 54
summary: Lugar 54 is a five-episode fiction series that takes place in a parking lot, exploring the characters that live a single parking spot throughout each episode. Each episode approaches a different genre, from drama, to comedy, to fantasy and crime.

name: House of Knives
summary: House of Knives, where talented, innovative and ruthless contenders must use their cooking, strategy and survival skills to make it to the throne. The competition names a weekly ruler based on challenges that reflect the contenders' personal stories, food influences and cultures, while the least successful chefs are banished. There are always six players in the game, so eliminations are followed with a dramatic reveal: a brand-new legendary chef entering the arena.

name: Anne Shirley
summary: Anne, an imaginative 11-year-old orphan, is mistakenly sent to live with the Cuthberts, elderly siblings who wanted a boy to help on their fields. Despite the initial misunderstanding, Anne's charm and spirit eventually win them over.

previousepisode.name: It's the Birthday of Our Happiness

name: The Prisoner of Love
summary: Princess Xiao Ningyun of Tianyun Kingdom becomes a blood slave after her nation fell. She is bought by Prince Duan of Daliang, Chen Fengxue, who torments her due to past grudges. Yet, as he uses her for his own purposes, he finds himself drawn to her without him knowing. After enduring numerous trials, they resolve their misunderstandings and confess their true feelings to one another. In the end, they choose to retreat into seclusion together in the mountains.

name: Bestiale
summary: Yrehn, an Osamodas who loathes Men because of their cruelty towards animals and other living beings, is none other than the guardian of Elante: a legendary creature coveted by many opportunists because of its powerful magical virtues. One day, Elante is captured by the meat gang, a group of mafiosi determined to take advantage of her unique abilities! Yrehn immediately rushes to his aid, and begins a great adventure alongside her new friend Tim, during which she prepares to discover that all men are not necessarily evil, and that the world is in reality composed multiple shades of gray...

name: The Dreamcatchers
summary: Four indigenous tweens discover that their ancestors have given them superpowers to defend Mother Earth from invasive species and evil corporations, whose destructive activities are revealed to them in dreams.

name: Takedown with Chris Hansen
summary: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So his mission continues.

name: Eşref Rüya
summary: As a child, Eşref fell in love from afar with a girl he called "Rüya" and spent years searching for her, only to become a powerful mafia figure along the way. Meanwhile, Nisan, an idealistic musician, finds herself in grave danger after performing at a wedding held at Eşref's hotel. Eşref falls for Nisan, unaware that she is both the long-lost Rüya he has been chasing for years and a police informant. Trapped in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles, Eşref is forced into a brutal reckoning — both with his criminal empire and his own emotions.

name: KPOPPED
summary: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.

name: Dood Spoor
summary: Ed Bex is a man with an eating disorder: as soon as he puts something in his mouth, he sees what happened to it. He uses this special gift in his unusual job: with 'The Last Greeting' he helps relatives to reconstruct the last hours of their dearly deceased. When Inspector Adams finds a body in an airtight bag, he asks for Ed's help. Ed has doubts: does he want to use his gift in a murder case? When he does get stuck into the case, he becomes entangled in a mix of absurd situations, personal chaos and deep pangs of conscience.

name: Bada Naam Karenge
summary: Rishabh and Surbhi's arranged marriage hits turbulence as past secrets resurface. Amid light moments, they navigate an unfolding bond, torn between desires and cultural norms.

name: Arlington Road
summary: On his way home, Michael, a professor specializing in the history of terrorism, saves the life of a seriously injured boy. He then meets the parents, Oliver and Cheryl, who live in his neighborhood. They sympathize. But Michael is intrigued by a plan he sees at Oliver's house. When he finds out that the latter was not educated in Kansas as he claims, Michael persuades himself that Oliver is hiding something and decides to investigate. He then realizes that his neighbor had assumed the identity of a dead man years ago.

name: Hollywood Arts
summary: Hollywood Arts follows Trina Vega returning to her old stomping grounds as the newest teacher at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.

name: The Joe Rogan Experience
summary: Joe Rogan hosts long form conversations with friends and guests that include comedians, actors, musicians, MMA instructors and commentators, authors and artists.

name: Prisoner
summary: Prisoner — a high-stakes action thriller following a principled young prison officer escorting a dangerous, high-value prisoner to court to testify against his elite crime syndicate.

name: Instant Italian
summary: Instant Italian works to take favorite Italian dishes and make them quick and easy for modern home cooks. Drawing on inspiration from her childhood visiting family in Calabria, Anna is known for her ingenious spins on familiar dishes. Whether she is transforming pasta with a snackable fried version (just minutes in an air fryer), perfecting a deeply flavored chicken cacciatore for an easy sheet-pan supper, or putting a creative twist on desserts like affogato mug cake and cannoli icebox cake, Anna is always finding fun and unique ways to update meals while still keeping the flavors true to their roots.

name: Schmeichel
summary:
Schmeichel is not just a story of a sport icon and his success; it's also a touching family story of triumphs, setbacks, and personal redemption.

The two-part documentary delves into Schmeichel's astonishing 22-year football career and life beyond the sport. Featuring unprecedented access to the international sporting hero, with a mix of never-before-seen personal archive footage, interviews with Peter Schmeichel, his family and key figures such as Sir Alex Ferguson, Eric Cantona and Gary Neville who have been a part of his journey both on and off the pitch.  

Schmeichel played a key role in the Danish national team's sensational victory at the 1992 UEFA European Championship and was an indispensable part of Manchester United's most successful era under Sir Alex Ferguson.

name: GibsonTV The Collection
summary: GibsonTV The Collection: Join host Mark Agnesi to get a close-up look at the guitar collections of some of the world's most iconic guitarists and singer-songwriters. In this exclusive series, your favorite musical icons share stories about their most prized and most recognizable guitars.

name: Naati Pinky Ki Lambi Love Story
Чудо-доктор
summary: Nadya Chudova, a graduate of the Moscow Medical Academy, decides to work in a provincial hospital in her hometown after graduating, where she was once saved by a talented surgeon, Andrei Krylov. Nadya gives the impression of being an eccentric, but in fact has a unique gift for seeing illness with the help of synesthesia, a neurological phenomenon that appeared after an accident she experienced in her youth. Although her unusual abilities help her in her work, they cause irony and ridicule among those around her.

name: Roses and Ivy
summary: A devoted sister's attempt to help her only sibling conceive stirs buried jealousy and anger, shattering their bond and leaving pain, broken loyalty, and lost love.

previousepisode.name: A Closet Enemy vs an Angel in Deed

name: El minuto heroico: Yo también dejé el Opus Dei
summary: Thirteen brave women share stories of the psychological, emotional and economic abuse they suffered under the controversial religious group Opus Dei.

previousepisode.name: Que nos miren a los ojos

name: Return of Fated Love
summary: Yu Chuxin and Zhou Chuming were once a sweet couple until Lin Qingqing's interference destroyed their marriage. After losing her child and nearly her life, Yu Chuxin, consumed by despair over her family's suffering, clings to her fraying sanity. She feigns selective amnesia, fixating her memory on the early days of her marriage to Zhou Chuming. Under this guise, she returns to the Zhou Family to covertly gather evidence, determined to ensure all who wronged her face justice.

name: Sweethearts
summary: From the creator of "Love is Blind" comes Sweethearts which follows the lives of 6 teenage couples in Charleston, SC. As they navigate the end of high school and get ready for college, each couple must decide if they will begin the next chapter of their lives together… or begin their adult lives single. Whatever they choose, one thing's for sure: it will change the course of their lives forever.

name: David Frost vs...
summary:
Pulling from an archive of more than 10,000 interviews recorded over nearly 50 years, David Frost Vs centres on era-defining interviews conducted by legendary broadcaster Sir David Frost. Seen through Frost's eyes, we encounter the flashpoints of the mid-to-late 20th century that made it a furnace of change and uncertainty, tumultuous times that continue to permeate our world today.

Across the series, Frost's career acts as a roughly chronological spine, as we journey through recent history via his astonishing rise, with commentary and insights from the Frost family and famous faces who knew him best. Each episode is anchored around Frost's interviews with one key personality, providing a jumping board into deeply resonant themes; from explosive encounters with Muhammad Ali on African American civil rights, to the deeply divisive student protest movement against the Vietnam War framed through Frost's conversations with Jane Fonda, and exploring the dark side of fame via revealing interviews with Sir Elton John.

previousepisode.name: David Frost vs The Middle East

name: EXchange: Another Beginning
summary: The beloved casts from the hit reality series — EXchange: Seasons 1, 2, and 3 — reunite for an exciting new chapter! This spin-off focuses on new dynamics, unexpected connections, and captivating chemistry as past participants embark on thrilling journeys together. Centered around travel and friendships, the show promises heartfelt moments and unforgettable experiences.

name: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses
summary: The hero Toto has talent, but his shyness has prevented him from forming a party. As he languishes in the town of origins, three beautiful women—Ciel, Anemone, and Goa—invite Toto to join their party out of the blue. Toto gears up to begin the journey, but unbeknownst to him, all three women are plotting to kill him for their own reasons!

previousepisode.name: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses

name: Reborn as a Space Mercenary
summary: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!

name: Mutant Weather
summary: Mutant Weather explores how weather patterns are changing and threatening life on our planet. The series explains why weather-related phenomena have dramatically transformed in the last few decades. Today's weather events are growing in size, speed and intensity, producing very unusual and often catastrophic anomalies.

name: Unconventional
summary: Unconventional is a bold, hilarious, and deeply authentic look at modern queer life. This irreverent comedy follows Noah Guillory, a queer millennial juggling a decade-long marriage, the uncertainty of fatherhood, and the chaos of academia—all while acting as a sperm donor for his sister's wife.

name: A Perfect Scam
summary: A deep dive into the sinister world of romance scams, financial frauds, and digital cons, showing how perpetrators manipulate trust and prey on human vulnerabilities. Through compelling interviews with victims, their families, and law enforcement, the series explores how seemingly harmless interactions can spiral into life-altering tragedies

name: Tiny House Nation: Memory Lane
summary: Everyone's favorite Tiny House experts John Weisbarth and Zack Giffin take a trip down memory lane where they'll count down their top 10 builds in each episode of this exciting new series.

name: Real Madrid: Cómo no te voy a querer
summary: In Real Madrid, the requirement to win all the titles puts its executives, coaching staff and players to the test every year. In the 2023-24 season, the club strengthens to build a roster that can rise to the challenge: completing a decade that can turn the team into a legend and writing a new golden chapter for the team in football's history.

name: Zlatniyat vek
summary: The action takes place in the 9th and 10th centuries during the reign of Simeon. This period is known as the" golden age " in Bulgarian history. In the time of Tsar Simeon, the independence of the Bulgarian Kingdom was established. Church books are translated into Bulgarian. Bulgarian bookishness is being created.

name: Only for Fans
summary: Danny, a content creator running an independent online channel, receives an unexpected proposal from Ho Yeon, a long-time fan.

name: Checkered Shirt
summary: A casual purchase of a Checkered Shirt through Karrot Market leads to an unexpected connection with a mysterious man, sparking curiosity and unspoken emotions. Jungwoo experiences lingering feelings and encounters new possibilities.

name: TwosomeBoys
summary: Despite the setback of not debuting with his original group and the emotional baggage he carries, Kang Min continues to practice relentlessly. He faces pressure to succeed, with reminders of his peers already debuting and achieving their dreams. One such day of practicing lends him a long overdue reunion with an ex-boyfriend of his - Su Ho, who used to train alongside Kang Min but is now a debuted idol, looking to practice in the dance room with his other two group members. Storming past the idols, Kang Min leaves the dance room, with Su Ho tailing behind hoping to make amends. Su Ho's attempts at reconciliation are met with anger and resentment, "Who can forget being betrayed by the person they trusted the most? How could that memory go away?"

name: Influencer lover
summary: Couple influencers, Eun Seong and Ji Yeon, have only dated for 3 months, but thanks to the algorithm, their popularity skyrocketed. Now broken up, they've been pretending to be a couple for 6 months! Just when everything seemed stable, Gang U enters the picture, leaving Eun Seong torn between his influencer life and true love.

name: Accent
summary: Having lived his entire life as a piano prodigy, Dong Uk finds himself envying Seong Hun's superior talent - but at the same time, he falls in love with him.

name: All for you
summary: A sweet romance between the president and the staff.

name: Royal Highness Princess
summary: Cui Xi Yue, the descendant of the princess exiled in a foreign country, changed her name to Hua Yue Er and sneaked into E country to avenge her enemy Ke Yi. She approached Ke Yi's beloved Wei Li and unexpectedly found that he was her childhood friend. During her revenge, she discovered that the real culprit was Ke Yi's brother Ke Yun, who had been eyeing her for a long time, and she fell into the "sweet trap" designed by him.

name: Mother and Mom
summary: The life of a three-generation mother-daughter in Daechi-dong, where Jung Eun, an avid working mother, prepares for her daughter's '7th birthday' and entrusts Ji Ah to drive her to school.

name: Love of Petals
summary: Gu Qingcheng, a young florist from the "Flower Capital" of Pingcheng, is guided by a mysterious firefly and accidentally inhales the "flower spirit" of a white peony while trying to save it. Little does she know, this white peony is actually Lyu Gengyun, a thousand-year-old half-demon. Since childhood, Gu Qingcheng has been determined to revive 9,999 flowers, following her father's dying wish, believing that once she succeeds, the Flower Immortal Lord will take her to the heavens to meet the person she longs for. That fateful night, Lyu Gengyun awakens within a giant white peony, and the sight convinces Gu Qingcheng that he is the Flower Immortal Lord. She immediately pledges herself as his disciple. Lyu Gengyun, seeking a way to extract the flower spirit from within her and uncover the truth behind his parents' wrongful fate, has no choice but to stay by her side under a false identity, waiting for the right opportunity. But to his shock, Gu Qingcheng turns out to be the infamous "Flower Thief" feared by many… As the two embark on a series of magical adventures, their hearts gradually draw closer. Yet, with the cycle of fate looming over them and the real Flower Immortal Lord  making his appearance, they are once again faced with a new wave of choices and challenges.
